title: The Vanishing Hours -- Episode 1: The Mary Celeste
description:
Real, sourced cases of people who vanished without explanation -- calmly told, perfect for falling asleep to. Episode 1: in 1872, a fully seaworthy ship was found adrift in the Atlantic. Her cargo was untouched, her sails still set. Ten people who'd been aboard her were simply gone.

Every case in this series is real and sourced -- see the sources list.
